svg.title: Tools
svg.desc: Trace Bloom section banner for Tools on lifehacker.dev. Honest reviews of software we actually ran. We name what we uninstalled and the free thing that beat it. A quantized lattice probed by 4 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Fallback cover for tool reviews that carry no banner of their own. Seed 1250363562.
